name: batch-4class
checklist_item: G. Classes / CF_PACK_ORIGINALS -- four classes exercised in ONE fight
description: The default shape: four of our five classes acting in a single fight, four times the coverage per boot. Vampiric, Pacifist, Pokemon Trainer and Gary each take one action with its own paired evidence.
notes: Five classes do not fit one party, which is why the battery is two batches: this one plus batch-chaos. Chaos Mage is in the other because its headline feature (the hazard tile) needs the whole board clean to be readable.

The capturable target is BAT_CAVE_00 -- the ONLY capture empirically proven in this repo (docs/research/test-checklist.md:315 captured it, :340 sent it out the next fight at 16 HP, :562-566 the ball still held cfg=BAT_CAVE_00). The pack's own JELLY_* configs are overridden WITHOUT a PLAYTHING_* tag and would be refused.

The capture is gated on ROLL_TIER EQ PERFECT, so the capture STEP here is expected to read NO-FIRE on an unlucky seed. That is not a failure of the class -- it is why iso-gary-refusal exists in seed-search form. Do not re-run this hoping for the roll.

Every step names its actor, and bench.py refuses to fire a step whose actor is not the ACTIVE entity -- crucible_use_ability has no entity parameter and would otherwise fire as whoever happened to be up, producing a screenshot of the wrong class.

Enemy combatants report name=(null) in state (the display name lives only on the on-screen nameplate, e.g. "Cave Bat"), so a `name:` selector can NEVER resolve an enemy. Target enemies by `class:` -- measured 2026-08-26, when `name:Bat` reported SETUP-FAILED for the capture step while the bat was plainly on the board.

fixture.notes: BUILD RECIPE. New campaign -> CHARACTER CREATION for every slot. NEVER crucible_party_set_class: it rewrites ConfigName but not the display name, so the class is right in state and every screenshot shows a stale vanilla name -- that voided a whole verification run here. Save, copy the .ftk2 out of GameRuns\ into %USERPROFILE%\Backups\ftk2-fixtures under this name, then set status to 'built'. Slots: 1 = Vampiric, 2 = Pacifist, 3 = Pokemon Trainer, 4 = Gary. Confirm all four DISPLAY names with crucible_party_list after loading -- fixture_health only checks file SIZE and has certified a content-corrupted save healthy for a whole session.

built.how: CHARACTER CREATION on the live party screen (never crucible_party_set_class); slot class set via the Customization-screen selection lever

setup.why: godmode ON tops HP up every tick and masks every HP effect.

Thin the encounter to TWO real monsters rather than clearing it. A body made by crucible_combat_spawn has NO StatusEffectComponent, so it can neither carry nor report a status -- measured 2026-08-26 in iso-ash-commands, where the identical FOCUS FIRE proc stamped ARMORDOWN on an encounter rat and left a spawned jelly at statuses=[] (which reads as a status that failed to land, not as UNREADABLE). a_enemy_armordown therefore has to point at a REAL monster; keeping two leaves enemy:0 and enemy:1 both real, since spawns are appended after them.

enemies.why: HP 16 / ATK 10 -- feeds Vampiric's Engorged and Gary's ON_KILL without threatening the party
the only target with a proven successful capture in this repo

steps.label: VAMPIRIC attacks -- Blood Price, Crimson Drain and Engorged

tells.expect: the ACTION MENU header names Vampiric and lists that class's own abilities. Taken before the fire, so the actor still holds the turn. Any of Shepherd / Thief / Corsair / Bladedancer voids the run.
the active-character banner and the highlighted party card BOTH read "Vampiric" -- captured before the fire, so this is the character that actually acts

an Engorged icon on the Vampiric portrait, duration 3 -- status icons render in the small icon strip directly ABOVE each party card, which is in the `party` region; `portraits` is the ally-MINION card and shows the Trainer's partner, not a party status.

the preview panel for the Vampiric's selected attack DOES carry a damage line (e.g. "N-M Physical Damage"). This is the CONTROL for the Pacifist's p_preview_no_damage tell in the same run and the same panel: without it, 'no damage line' could just mean the panel never shows one

steps.label: PACIFIST plays Here's a Shield on the Vampiric -- no damage

tells.expect: the ACTION MENU header names Pacifist and lists that class's own abilities. Taken before the fire, so the actor still holds the turn. Any of Shepherd / Thief / Corsair / Bladedancer voids the run.
the active-character banner and the highlighted party card BOTH read "Pacifist" -- captured before the fire, so this is the character that actually acts

an Armour Up icon on the VAMPIRIC portrait (the target), not on the Pacifist -- status icons render in the small icon strip directly ABOVE each party card, which is in the `party` region; `portraits` is the ally-MINION card and shows the Trainer's partner, not a party status.

the ability preview panel for "Here's a Shield" carries NO damage line. A normal ability shows one there (e.g. "0-9 Magic Damage"); its ABSENCE is the whole thesis of the Pacifist class -- it buffs without dealing damage. Capture is `when: before`, while the ability is still selected and the panel is populated

steps.label: POKEMON TRAINER fires FOCUS FIRE -- the charge lands on ALL allies

asserts.why: Target: ALLY_ALL -- a command that only buffs its caster is not a command

tells.expect: the ACTION MENU header names Pokemon Trainer and lists that class's own abilities. Taken before the fire, so the actor still holds the turn. Any of Shepherd / Thief / Corsair / Bladedancer voids the run.
the active-character banner and the highlighted party card BOTH read "Pokemon Trainer" -- captured before the fire, so this is the character that actually acts
a "Focus Fire" icon on EVERY party card, not only the Trainer's -- that is the group-buff tell

steps.label: GARY throws the Capture Ball at the bat (PERFECT-gated)

tells.expect: the ACTION MENU header names Gary and lists that class's own abilities. Taken before the fire, so the actor still holds the turn. Any of Shepherd / Thief / Corsair / Bladedancer voids the run.
the active-character banner and the highlighted party card BOTH read "Gary" -- captured before the fire, so this is the character that actually acts
on a PERFECT roll the bat is GONE from the enemy side; on any other roll the refusal text "CAN’T BE CAUGHT!" is on screen and the bat is still there. Record which
all four party cards read Vampiric, Pacifist, Pokemon Trainer and Gary. Any of Shepherd / Thief / Corsair / Bladedancer means the fixture was built with set_class and NOTHING in this run is evidence
four player bodies on the player side and the surviving enemies on theirs

seed_search.found_note: the seed on which the Pacifist's Here's a Shield rolls PERFECT and its ADD_STATUS actually lands. The ability preview reads 83% per slot / 77% perfect, so a miss is ordinary luck, not a broken skill -- and with the pin genuinely replacing the generator the SAME seed misses every time (verified: seeds 20260826 twice, identical p_armorup FAIL and identical v_target_hurt -6), which is exactly why this has to be seed-searched rather than re-run.
